source: NCHS National Vital Statistics Reports vol. 70 no. 5, Table 1 — total fertility rate by educational attainment of the mother, 2019.
note: TFR is births per woman (NCHS publishes per 1,000 women; figures here are divided by 1,000). This is the latest NCHS table that splits TFR by education. Later final-births reports publish TFR by race and Hispanic origin, not by schooling.
